steps.text: Heat oil, lemon juice and onion in a large skillet over medium heat. When onion is tender, add chicken, mushrooms and tomatoes.
Cook over medium high heat for 5 to 7 minutes each side, stirring occasionally, or until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside.

raw_recipe.headline: T's Easy Chicken
raw_recipe.description: Chicken breast, mushrooms and tomatoes cooked with a little olive oil, lemon and onion. A simple one skillet dish that's sure to please.
raw_recipe.name: T's Easy Chicken

review.reviewBody:
As most other reviewers noted, this was a great base. Some changes I made: I scaled to 4 servings and cut the chicken into pieces. 
I added more mushrooms, garlic, and tomatoes. I also put a bit of sugar to cut the acidity of both lemon and tomatoes. 
I originally cut all the veggies up and put it one bowl with the garlic, lemon juice, sugar and tomatoes then added that to the pan after I cooked the chicken and set it aside. 
Just because of timing I ended up simmering the whole thing for a few minutes. 
The end result..you have a thin sauce that goes great with pasta and you can taste a hint of lemon.

Love it! Nice and light. If you want to make it into a little more comfort-type food -- skip the lemon, add 1 clove garlic, 1/2 tsp oregano - brown chicken/garlic first, mix together tomato/spices (salt to taste), add 2 T. to 1/4 c. dry vermouth (depending on how much you like it) simmer, then top with italian mix cheese at the end,cook just long enough to melt the cheese.

This was five star for me, with a tiny bit of tweaking. I used 1/2 cup of diced onion instead of a quarter, I minced 3 cloves of garlic and cooked that with the onion, omitted the mushrooms completely, and diced 2 whole tomatoes, which was definitely more than the 1/2 cup the recipe called for, added 1 teaspoon of sugar, and finally gave a sprinkle of salt throughout once the chicken was in the pan as well as a generous dash of pepper. All that being said, I may increase it even more next time, because sauce that it made was DELICIOUS. Served the chicken breast on a bed of white buttered rice, and then spooned some of the sauce over the whole thing. YUMMY!!

A delightful dish--and so easy!! I made just a couple of changes: cut the chicken breasts in thirds; added about a teaspoon of minced garlic and a few shakes of Italian seasoning; used sort of a stir-fry technique to cook. At the end, I sprinkled the whole thing with generous portions of mozzarella and romano and shoved the skillet in a hot oven for a few minutes to melt the cheese and cook the chicken a bit more. It was tender and delicious--a dish I will make often. Thumbs up from the boys--thanks so much.

I have made this recipe numerous times and it still remains one of my favorites. I do change a few things, however. I cut the chicken up into bite size pieces and I add the whole can of diced tomatoes. This creates a lite sauce that we use to serve over pasta. Thank you so much for sharing this recipe!!

This was an easy recipe, and it tasted very nice. Next time I serve it with pasta I will double everything but the chicken. I'd prefer a little more sauce. Like others, I browned the chicken with the onions, then added the other ingredients.

As a base recipe this was very good. I added Sage, Thyme, Garlic powder, black pepper and Lawry's season salt with the chicken and mushrooms. You can use the sauce and pour over the chicken breast or as I did, served overcooked rotini. I also used leg quarters instead of breasts. Awesome results!

This was delicious! I used what I had on hand in the house, so the recipe was tweaked a little. First I sauteed chopped onion, minced garlic and cubed chicken in olive oil. Then I added a can of diced tomatoes w/ mild green chiles, and green beans. I added some lemon juice, italian seasoning and salt. This was served over brown rice w/ shredded cheddar on top.

Tracy, this is a great recipe! I was looking for something that was quick & easy, and called for things I had on hand. I only had canned Mexican tomatoes with lime & cilantro, so I skipped the lemon juice, and added fresh chopped cilantro at the end of cooking. I followed other's suggestions, and cut the chicken in smaller pieces and added fresh garlic and more mushrooms & onions. I also cooked the chicken with the onions, then added the mushrooms, finally adding the tomatoes. I served mashed potatoes along side this dish, and there was nothing left over. It was a huge hit with the whole family! Next time I'll either try it with regular or Italian flavored canned tomatoes.

This is a really nice recipe. It's not fancy, but it is good. I cooked everything in a different order: first browned chicken in oil, added onion, added garlic, added tomatoes and lemon juice. I also added some Italian herbs and topped the chicken with cheese. I didn't have any mushrooms--it was still good over rice. Tip: I always add a tsp of sugar to canned tomatoes, I think they taste fresher.

Used boneless, skinless chicken thighs instead of chicken breasts. I quickly scanned the reviews, and some people were using canned tomatoes and others fresh tomatoes (recipe not clear about what to use). I used fresh tomatoes, and would always do that. I did add some black olives which I had in the fridge, and again, certainly would do that again. This turned out pretty well, was super simple to make, and I’d make again.

I liked the lemony flavor very much, the mushrooms (canned) were puckering! I’ll add some garlic prior to adding the chicken and I’ll use fresh mushrooms next time. Oh, I used thigh meat cut off the bone, into chunks. It was easy! Paired it with Parmesan Couscous.
I make this ALL the time!! My family loves it. Very clean tasting!! ??
Tastes great. Very yummy, especially if you use fire roasted tomatoes.
love it!

Simple and delicious! I used fresh tomatoes and served this over spaghetti squash for a super healthy meal. I also added some freshly chopped basil and garlic. I gave it 4 stars for this original recipe, but would give it 5 stars with my modifications. I will definitely use this recipe again!
This was tasty, but the BF felt like there was something missing. I think garlic might enhance the flavor.
Really surprised at how good it was being so simple.
Easy to make and tasty. I added extra seasonings of garlic and Italian herbs. Also I served the chicken sprinkled with Parmasan Cheese.
Easy says it all. This is a great recipe that I can usually make at a moment's notice and everyone in my family likes it.
